reports.name: Regularized screw dislocation motion and reactions
limitations: Straight screw sections and a softened pair closure; curved-line dynamics are not implemented.
Isolated stress energy and pair energy have distinct near-core closures.
The velocity-stress test verifies the specified linear drag law; a material-calibrated curve remains open.
reports.timing_notes: Unclassified time includes uninstrumented setup/diagnostics. Peak RSS includes interpreter, imports, solver temporaries and diagnostic audit grids, measured before file I/O.

reports.name: Screw interaction with a fixed diffuse interface
limitations: Binding and glide across a prescribed diffuse profile are demonstrated.
Midplane crossing is not crystallographic transmission.
Absorption, reflection, slip-system selection, residual interfacial Burgers content and their barriers are uncalibrated and disabled.
reports.timing_notes: Unclassified time includes uninstrumented setup/diagnostics. Peak RSS includes interpreter, imports, solver temporaries and diagnostic audit grids, measured before file I/O.

reports.name: Vacancy-coupled pore growth and shrinkage
limitations: Two-dimensional closed-inventory analogue; no gas, elasticity, nucleation or fracture.
Quantitative Gibbs-Thomson and growth-law convergence, and an adaptive comparison remain open.
reports.timing_notes: Unclassified time includes uninstrumented setup/diagnostics. Peak RSS includes interpreter, imports, solver temporaries and diagnostic audit grids, measured before file I/O.

reports.name: Coupled defect population, screw dipole and diffuse inclusion
limitations: 0D defects are populations, lines are straight sections, and plasticity is one analytical mean-shear mode.
No local 3D crystal plasticity, curved-line topology, disclinations or crystallographic transmission.
The reference uses the same sparse lines with uniform fields; it is a uniform-field hybrid reference, not an all-field dislocation PF model.
The full residual-per-cost allocation policy is not implemented.
